title: Cocktail Recipe Bundle
author: Design Owl
description:
Cocktail Recipe Bundle
Download these fun, cocktail recipe illustrations suitable for a range of possible product ideas including: Kitchen towels, drinks coasters, tumblers, printable wall art, signs and more!
Included:
14 different cocktail recipe designs – Choose from metric or imperial measures (ML or FL OZ)
28 x PNG file – 12 x 12 inches (transparent background)
28 x JPG file – 12 x 12 inches
All images are 300 dpi and saved in RGB format
Intended to be printed on a white background.
Thank you for visiting Design Owl.
